item.title: ‘Remember the Alamo’: Wreaths laid at San Antonio site on 190th anniversary of crucial Texas battle
item.description: The lawn in front of the iconic site was filled with wreaths placed by groups from all over the U.S. as speakers read aloud letters from people who witnessed the bravery of the Texian defenders during the 13-day siege by Mexican troops led by Santa Anna.

item.title: Texas AG investigating Austin ISD over alleged 'biological male' using girls' restrooms, locker rooms
item.description: The complaint alleges that both Austin ISD and Austin High are aware that a "biological male" has been using girls' restrooms and locker rooms. The AG says this is in violation of Senate Bill 8.

item.title: Austin police no longer authorized to make arrests, detentions based on ICE admin warrant
item.description: The orders now outline the actions an officer will take if they learn that someone in their custody has an ICE administrative warrant versus an ICE detainer request.

item.title: Austin 6th Street shooting: APD officers respond in less than 1 minute
item.description: The Austin Police Department is getting recognition for their rapid response to the mass shooting at a west 6th Street bar. Police said 19 people were shot, including the gunman, on March 1 at Buford's. In 57 seconds, Austin police officers arrived on the scene. Officers responded to the call for help in record time."We're not talking about minutes," said Michael Bullock, the President of the Austin Police Association. item.title: Austin 6th Street shooting: Buford's announces reopening, donation of sales
item.description: The west 6th Street bar where a mass shooting took place this past weekend has announced its reopening plans. A total of 19 people, including the gunman, were shot outside the bar on Sunday, March 1. Three victims have died, including two college students. The bar, Buford's Backyard Beer Garden, announced they will reopen on Friday, March 6 at 6 p.m.They will also donate 100 percent of all sales from Friday through Sunday to the victims and families who were impacted by the shooting.
